flow_name: Tablets: Devices menu -> Tablets listing -> iPad Pro product configuration

_provenance.note: Every canonical step target below was clicked or asserted on the live dev site with installed Chrome at 1500 ms pacing, and resolved to one visible element. Replaces the 2026-09 flow written against devnew-sas.etisalat.ae, whose /eshop routes now return 404.

automation_boundary.automated_scope: Accessories page -> Devices mega menu -> Tablets listing (cards, Search, Sort by, Device Storage filter, Load more) -> iPad Pro M4 configuration (storage, connectivity, display glass, colour, payment plans, Specs, stock state, breadcrumb) -> Cart page.
automation_boundary.external_boundary: Live Payment Gateway (Credit Card / OTP). Add to cart cannot succeed on dev (2026-10-20): the cart service returns 417 for in-stock SKUs (DEV-CART-01) and every iPad Pro M4 SKU is out of stock.

canonical_steps.action: Navigate to the e& Accessories page
canonical_steps.expected_result: The Accessories page loads with the 'Accessories For' section
The cookie banner is dismissed
The Devices mega menu opens
The Tablets listing page opens at /eshop/devices/listing/tablets

canonical_steps.action: Verify the Tablets listing shows product cards
canonical_steps.expected_result: Product cards with name and price are displayed

canonical_steps.action: Type '11-inch' in the listing Search box and press Enter
canonical_steps.expected_result: Only 11-inch iPad Pro cards are listed
Sort options Popular, New, Price (Low to High), Price (High to Low) are shown
The sort label reads 'Price (Low to High)'
Storage options All, 32gb, 64gb, 128gb, 256gb, 512gb are listed
The listing reloads filtered by storage (URL carries device_storage)
12 more product cards are appended (24 in total)

canonical_steps.action: Open the 'iPad Pro M4, 11-inch' product card
canonical_steps.expected_result: The iPad Pro M4, 11-inch configuration page opens

canonical_steps.action: Verify the product title 'Apple iPad Pro M4, 11-inch'
canonical_steps.expected_result: The product title is displayed
'512GB' becomes the active storage option
'Wi-Fi' becomes the active connectivity option
'Standard glass' becomes the active display glass option
The selected colour reads 'Space Black'

canonical_steps.action: Verify the '24 months' payment plan is shown with its monthly price
canonical_steps.expected_result: Plans One time, 24 months, 18 months and 12 months are displayed with AED prices
Specifications (Display, Processor/Chip, Battery, Warranty) are displayed

canonical_steps.action: Verify the 'Add to cart' button is disabled for the out-of-stock SKU
canonical_steps.expected_result: 'Out of stock' is shown and 'Add to cart' is disabled

canonical_steps.action: Verify the 'Add to cart' button is enabled for an in-stock SKU
canonical_steps.expected_result: 'In stock' is shown and 'Add to cart' is enabled
The Tablets listing page opens
canonical_steps._note: Only after reaching the product from the Tablets listing; on a deep-linked product page the breadcrumb goes to the Smartphones listing (DEV-TAB-03).

canonical_steps.action: Navigate to the shopping cart page
canonical_steps.expected_result: The cart page shows 'You don't have any items in your cart'

iPad Pro M4, 11-inch.stock: All 24 SKUs out of stock on dev (2026-10-20)

iPad Pro M4, 13-inch.stock: All 24 SKUs out of stock on dev (2026-10-20)

11\" New iPad Pro, Wi-Fi.stock: In stock on 2026-10-20, OUT OF STOCK again on 2026-10-21: dev stock changes daily, so no case depends on it.

12.9\" New iPad Pro.stock: In stock on 2026-10-20, OUT OF STOCK again on 2026-10-21: dev stock changes daily, so no case depends on it.

unverified_from_brd._status: Described by the purchase journey and not confirmed in the application: no stock on dev
unverified_from_brd.note: Nothing here is from a BRD. Listed so the classifier and compiler treat these as not confirmed in the application.

match: item is added to the cart
add_to_cart_success.detail: Add to cart fails on dev (2026-10-20): POST /b2c/eshop/addToShoppingCartOneByOne returns 417 'Internal server error' even for in-stock SKUs (DEV-CART-01), and every iPad Pro M4 SKU is out of stock.
